C1415.title: HEALTH Token Price Manipulation Incident
C1415.summary: In May 2023, an attacker exploited a smart contract vulnerability on the BSC chain by taking a flash loan of WBNB, swapping it for HEALTH tokens on PancakeSwap, and repeatedly executing transfer operations to manipulate the token price. The attacker then reversed the swap to profit approximately 16 WBNB, leveraging flawed price calculation logic in the protocol.
